[G] DiagramService
|-- Public boundary: create, revise, generate, getRevision, listRevisions
|-- RevisionedDiagramService: sole diagram content writer
|   |-- create -> DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareCreate -> issue
|   |-- revise -> get base -> prepareEdit
|   |   `-- unchanged: reuse base; changed: issue child revision
|   |-- issue -> diagramRevisions.register
|   |   |-- registers diagram/revision identity and optional parentId
|   |   `-- correspondence + base nodeRefs -> reuse refs or assign UUIDs
|   |-- getRevision/listRevisions -> registry; list returns frozen summaries
|   `-- generate -> injected DiagramGenerator.generate(cloned request)
|       |-- checks abort and base/local diagram ID compatibility
|       `-- generated input -> revise(replace) or create(revision: 0)
|-- Request: instruction, input, optional AgentContext and baseRevisionId
|   `-- optional diagram, connections, selection and project context
`-- Local issuance is synchronous; durable adapters flush before publish
